date_note: ENEOS's notice gives no earlier day than its own date; it says the app service has been stopped since about 16:00 that day.
title: ENEOS detects unauthorized access to its official app and suspends the service
summary: ENEOS says it detected unauthorized third-party access to its official app and has stopped the service since about 16:00 on Nov 25 to prevent harm spreading and to check whether customer information leaked. App coupons and mobile EneKey are unavailable; service stations operate normally and cash, credit card and tag-type EneKey payments still work. Whether data leaked and its scope are under investigation.
plain: ENEOS has switched off its app after detecting unauthorized access. Coupons and mobile EneKey are unavailable, while stations and other payments work. It is still checking whether customer data leaked.
exec: ENEOS says fuel supply and sales are unaffected, but it has not said when the app will return.
action: ENEOS asks users not to open links or attachments, or enter personal or authentication details, in suspicious emails, SMS or calls posing as ENEOS.

validation.note: ENEOS's own notice read; Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays it.

review.note: Compared title, date, 16:00 stop, unavailable services, payments, advice against ENEOS notice and Cybersecurity.com
